pages.text: Press $(l)R$() to switch between battle stance and mining stance.$(br2)In battle stance: $(l)Left Alt$() dodges, $(l)right-click$() guards, $(l)G$() locks on, $(l)K$() opens the skill menu. Dodges, guards and weapon skills cost stamina.
Every weapon type swings differently. Greatswords and hammers hit hard and slow; daggers and katanas are quick. Find one you like and get good.
